# Merkan

> Merkan is a business-consulting company that helps foreign (especially Turkish) businesses enter the Iranian market. Since 1999, we have provided 25+ years of experience in import, trade, and market analysis, with offices in Ankara (Turkey) and Tabriz (Iran).

## About

Merkan links business needs with solutions, guiding manufacturers and companies through the Iranian market. We specialize in import/export, market entry, trade consulting, and market analysis across Iran, Turkey, and beyond. The website is available in Persian (default), English, and Turkish.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://merkan.ir/): Company overview and value proposition
- [About Us](https://merkan.ir/about): Mission, services, and our expertise
- [Services](https://merkan.ir/services): Import, trade, and market analysis services
- [How We Work](https://merkan.ir/how-we-work): Our collaboration process
- [Contact](https://merkan.ir/contact): Office addresses, phone, and WhatsApp contact details
